data.summary: Beispiel Versicherung AG asks the recipient to fill in and return a questionnaire describing the course of a traffic accident from 28 April 2026 (claim no. KH-26-0428-112), since the other party has made a liability claim. The questionnaire must be returned within 10 working days of the letter's date (6 May 2026).
data.explanation: The other driver involved in your accident has filed a liability claim against you with your insurer. To decide who is at fault, the insurer needs your own account of what happened. Fill in the enclosed questionnaire honestly and completely and send it back by the deadline shown — this is not yet a payment demand, just a request for information. If you miss the deadline, the insurer may have to decide the liability question without your side of the story, which could work against you. If anything about the accident is unclear or disputed, it can help to get advice before answering.
